name: offset-filleted-cutter
why: Growing a filleted body by a clearance and cutting it out is how a holder wraps a real object. MakeThickSolid returns that grown body inside out, and the cut then removed everything; the offset now checks the sign of its volume and reorients. The closed form is 162 070 mm3 to a few mm3 of fillet arithmetic; the pocket is 11 deep with 6 mm corners. B-rep only: edge fillets are exact-only.
